The bug is in `src/task-manager.ts` in the `updateTask` method. The current code does:

```js
const updated: Task = {
  ...existing,
  title: updates.title as any,
  description: updates.description as any,
  priority: updates.priority as any,
  status: updates.status as any,
  dueDate: updates.dueDate as any,
  updatedAt: toISOTimestamp(new Date()),
};
```

When a field is not included in the update (e.g., `{ title: "Updated" }`), `updates.description` is `undefined`, which overwrites the existing value. In JavaScript, `{ ...existing, title: undefined }` sets `title` to `undefined`.
